notes: One huge rally day (SPY up almost 5 percent, QQQ up 7 percent) sits inside a month that was deeply negative, and both are still below their 50-day and 200-day averages, with the VIX still near 27. I can't tell yet whether this is early recognition of a turn or just a bounce inside an unfinished decline, and the dollar rising alongside stocks while yields fell makes the picture too mixed to call. No clean flawed premise, no clean catalyst, no trade tonight. Watching whether SPY and QQQ actually reclaim their 50-day averages, and whether the dollar and stocks keep moving together, before committing capital.
